creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The list is always visible. At a full window of fifteen panes its two hundred points are two hundred points of terminal, and somebody driving one pane wants them back.

The interesting half is not the toggle, it is where the answer lives. The shell owns nothing, so a bool in MusterWindow is a second home for durable-ish view state. Composition is the obvious candidate - it is what Muster owns and what gets written down - but 'which daemons are attached and what each region shows' is a description of a session, and whether a list is open is not that.

Worth settling alongside a_27QcqNxRB (composition is a value, so it can be written down), because the answer is the same shape: either composition grows a notion of window presentation, or something beside it does.
title: 👁️ A sidebar you can put away
